emails.subject: Recruiting ops at SimWest Engineering Recruit
emails.body_html:
Hi Stephen, I saw you are Founder & Director at SimWest Engineering Recruitment.

Your kind of operation runs a manual engineering screening stage, with every machinery and manufacturing search personally managed by the founder.

I build supervised AI employees that carry that loop, one workflow at a time, with a person approving each step.

Is the shortlist stage still done by hand, or have you systemized it? If it is still manual, I'd be happy to map it with you.

Best,
Shayan
